rationale: Rerun the previously falsified Star PED data-only publication experiment after the generic waiting-period certification lineage repair. The experiment reuses the same governed publication spec shape and pressure tests generic waiting-period certification, publication authorization, authoritative materialization, frozen artifact persistence, and coverage-registry-backed published evidence lookup without governed runtime implementation changes.
supersession_impact: No capability, implementation, or historical artifact is superseded. This is a retry of the closed PR #238 experiment against the repaired generic certification lineage on current main.
authority_impact: No authority is broadened. Publication remains bounded to explicitly certified semantic components and explicit boundary authorization. Customer-specific PED buy-back selection, customer eligibility, and claim-payment determination remain unauthorized.
